expectations.text: No rewrite performed, even partial/optional; findings-only with at most a one-clause fix suggestion per finding
Verdict is human or ambiguous-leaning-human, not AI-generated
Watch-list words present, if flagged, described as weak/context-dependent, not proof
Gives a reason for restraint (low hit count, few distinct patterns, no structural tells)
States a hit count or rate relative to length
